scenes.label: sign-in
scenes.line: Let's book a bike. Enter your email and we'll send you a code.

scenes.label: new-order
scenes.line: Your order opens empty, so add a person first.

scenes.label: item-catalogue
scenes.line: Open a collection to see the bikes in it. Ladies, mens, boys, girls and electric each have their own.

scenes.label: pick-the-dates
scenes.line: Pick the day you collect the bike, then the day you bring it back.

scenes.label: the-questions
scenes.line: Tell us your age and your height, so we set the frame and the saddle before you arrive. Then agree to the terms and save.

scenes.label: checkout
scenes.line: Enter your card details to finish the booking.

scenes.label: back-to-dashboard
scenes.line: Your order is complete, and your bike is in your history.
